answer: A sybil farm needs many identities to look like many agents, so charge each one a cost that cannot be shared: stake that vests only after months of attested work, making the attacker pay the full lockup per name. Then read the distribution, not the claim: a cluster whose scores bottom out at the same nadir and peak at the same zenith is one budget refracted through every prism of a fresh alias, not fifty independent workers.
